title: with-tokens.sh: remove the WITH_TOKENS_ALLOWLIST override (any agent could allowlist any token)
spec:
Security fix for scripts/with-tokens.sh (merged in PR 41, 3941301). The allowlist path can be overridden with the
environment variable WITH_TOKENS_ALLOWLIST (scripts/with-tokens.sh:26). Any agent can write its own allowlist in /tmp,
set that variable and receive every token in the store, which defeats the human-owned allowlist entirely.
Found by the Planner on 2026-10-05 after merge; the security review T-1656 missed it.

Change:
1. scripts/with-tokens.sh always reads <repo root>/.orchestrator/token-allowlist.txt, where repo root is the parent of
   the script's own directory (as today). Remove the WITH_TOKENS_ALLOWLIST override completely. If the variable is set
   in the environment, refuse with exit 3 "with-tokens: WITH_TOKENS_ALLOWLIST is not supported" so a caller relying on it
   notices.
2. Keep WITH_TOKENS_F_SH (a fake f.sh only yields fake values; no privilege gain) but update the header comment to say
   it exists for tests only.
3. Update the header comment: the allowlist location is fixed and protected by protected-paths.txt.

Tests (tests/test_with_tokens.py): stop using WITH_TOKENS_ALLOWLIST. Each test copies scripts/with-tokens.sh into a temp
directory laid out as <tmp>/scripts/with-tokens.sh and writes <tmp>/.orchestrator/token-allowlist.txt, then runs the copy.
Keep all eight existing tests green with that layout and add:
- test_allowlist_override_env_refused: WITH_TOKENS_ALLOWLIST set to a temp file listing b-key -> exit 3, the message
  above, no value in output, command not run.
- test_allowlist_location_fixed: a second allowlist elsewhere is ignored; only <root>/.orchestrator/token-allowlist.txt counts.
Run: uv run python -m pytest -q tests/test_with_tokens.py (or unittest). Commit on the task branch.
acceptance: tests/test_with_tokens.py: the eight existing tests plus test_allowlist_override_env_refused and test_allowlist_location_fixed pass
scripts/with-tokens.sh reads only <repo root>/.orchestrator/token-allowlist.txt and refuses when WITH_TOKENS_ALLOWLIST is set
